local_assignment_material.finding: The quiz PDF pages 4-5 reproduce competition overview/data-description screenshots; they do not expose a verified exact watched predicate.

implementation_implication: Primary label remains the documented local approximation: airing coverage >= 80%, rank programmes by count of qualifying airings, take top 5 or fewer, tie-break ascending programme id.
Primary evaluation does not apply the secondary article's concurrent-channel/no-channel-change condition.
Any claim that local labels exactly reproduce Kaggle scoring would be unsupported.
